scope: Production core.TxPool (core/tx_pool.go, core/tx_list.go) and quaiapi pool handlers behind rpc.Server over a test chain: committed state per head, the UTXO set in the database, work objects with transactions. Runs (runReorg) at explicit steps instead of the 1-second ticker; eviction and Qi expiry by the production loops after aging. Sharing clients are local httptest servers. Fixed-seed keys; no network, no real funds. protobuf-go's per-binary non-breaking space after 'proto:' is written as a regular space.
